title: Epic unveils a refresh of its Epic Games Launcher for PC in preview, saying that the new version is "vibe coded" and "way faster", and now supports Linux (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Epic unveils a refresh of its Epic Games Launcher for PC in preview, saying that the new version is “vibe coded” and “way faster”, and now supports Linux — Epic is making a big push into AI-assisted development, and that approach includes its work on the new, faster launcher.
contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Epic unveils a refresh of its Epic Games Launcher for PC in preview, saying that the new version is “vibe coded” and “way faster”, and now supports Linux   —  Epic is making a big push into AI-assisted development, and that approach includes its work on the new, faster launcher.﻿
